instruction: I find it distracting when VLC pauses playback if the window loses focus. Please adjust VLC Media Player settings to continue playing videos even when the window is not active.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC's pause-on-focus-loss behavior cannot be automatically evaluated. Testing would require window focus manipulation and playback state monitoring which is not supported.
metadata.infeasible_reason: VLC focus-based playback behavior requires runtime testing with window state changes

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - verification requires dynamic window focus manipulation and real-time playback state monitoring
The behavior (pause-on-focus-loss) cannot be verified through static config file checks alone - it requires runtime behavioral testing
Current framework lacks support for window focus state manipulation and concurrent focus/playback state monitoring

Infeasible marking is appropriate and well-justified in the metadata explanation
